title: An invoiced work order that also holds a deposit shows the invoiced message
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced (not paid), billed to customer B, with a $10.00 deposit taken before it was invoiced and not reversed.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Hover over the Bill To field.
  4. Click the Bill To field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A, with status Invoiced.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 3:

  • The tooltip reads "Invoiced. Reverse the invoice to change who's billed."
  • The deposit message does not show.

Step 4:

  • The error toast shows "Invoiced. Reverse the invoice to change who's billed." with "Go To Invoice".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
